research_question: After successful baseline failure reproduction, if administrative controller phase navigation is handled deterministically and frozen RAW Qwen is placed directly at the existing RUNTIME_EVIDENCE interaction boundary, can it use the existing simplified debugger command surface to enter a real PDB interaction loop?

source_baseline.note: D1 is based on the accepted S1 source commit. The live run binds to the committed clean HEAD (source_commit_sha) which must descend from this accepted S1 baseline. D1 adds files under experiments/debugger_interaction_v2_d1/ only; production core and S1 files are unchanged.

d1_treatment.description: D1 changes only administrative controller phase navigation after verified reproduction. After the model's own reproduce action produces a real observation with failure_reproduced == true, the experiment-local D1 harness deterministically performs the existing legal administrative transitions REPRODUCE -> UNDERSTAND -> RUNTIME_EVIDENCE, then calls the RAW model using the EXISTING S1 RUNTIME_EVIDENCE state-specific command surface. From that point onward, model debugger/action choices remain model-authored.
d1_treatment.automation_trigger: real run_reproduction observation with failure_reproduced == true
d1_treatment.stop_rule: If successful reproduction does not occur, STOP; do not force runtime entry.

treatment_differences_from_s1.description: S1 left REPRODUCE->UNDERSTAND->RUNTIME_EVIDENCE to the model, which fixated on the reproduce self-loop (Live Run 1, frozen). D1 automates ONLY these two administrative phase transitions after verified reproduction; the model-facing RUNTIME_EVIDENCE prompt, bridge grammar, controller, tools, PDB backend, verifier, and budgets are unchanged.

frozen_variables.tokenizer_chat_template: frozen at base revision (same as v1)
frozen_variables.quantization: 4-bit NF4 with double quantization (same as v1)

gate_b_criteria.description: Interaction loop (not one-shot). All four conditions must hold. Administrative transitions inserted by the D1 harness do NOT count as model debugger commands.
conditions: 1. RAW model emits a valid debugger command accepted by the controller that reaches the real PDB backend.
2. A real PDB observation is produced and bound into the next model request via prior_observation_id + rendered_observation_sha256 provenance.
3. After receiving that request, the model emits a second accepted debugger command.
4. That second command also reaches the real PDB backend and produces another real observation.

gate_c_criteria.description: Full dynamic trajectory: runtime evidence -> post-debug diagnosis -> patch -> verifier.

claims_boundary: D1 is a single-run interface sanity diagnostic of the S1 STOP gate. It is NOT a new protocol campaign, NOT S1 v2.1, NOT a prompt-optimization campaign, and NOT a general repair pass. A successful D1 supports only: under the S1 simplified/direct-access treatment with deterministic administrative phase navigation after verified reproduction, frozen RAW Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct can (or cannot) enter a real PDB interaction loop on curated-off-by-one-002.
